mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in housing starts signals a growing economy, leading to increased consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances with strong housing starts growth.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 2.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle, leading to decreased borrowing and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of instances with high federal funds rates.

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate below 4% signals a strong labor market, leading to increased consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 30% of instances with low unemployment rates.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in retail sales and a decrease in unemployment rate signal a growing economy, leading to increased consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances with strong retail sales growth and low unemployment rates.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production signals an increase in economic output, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances with strong industrial production growth.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate and an increase in the consumer price index signal an expansionary monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances with low federal funds rates and high consumer price index growth.

mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in GDP signals a growing economy, leading to increased consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances with strong GDP growth.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in payroll employment and a low unemployment rate signal a strong labor market, leading to increased consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 30% of instances with strong payroll employment growth and low unemployment rates.
